Extracted requirements exactly as returned (mode=bench-readiness&emit=requirements). Tender quotes are re-verified against the live tender on every chained run.

requirements.requirement: Design a system that allows growth over the next 5 to 10 years.
requirements.quote: The Council want a system which will allow growth over the next 5 to 10 years.

requirements.requirement: Add extra cameras at the specified new locations: Harry Baker and Charles Read Pavilions, the Anstey Lane car park and parking area at Energique, and the Council compound at Anstey Park.
requirements.quote: The Council is looking to add extra cameras in specific locations, these include:

requirements.requirement: Provide the maintenance contract for three years from 1 November 2026, ending 31 October 2029.
requirements.quote: The contract will then run for three years and will end on 31st October 2029.

requirements.requirement: Review the existing system to identify coverage and supply issues at existing locations, including tree obstruction now and during the contract period.
requirements.quote: Review the existing system to identify the coverage and any supply issues for the existing locations.

requirements.requirement: A site visit is recommended; arrange it by contacting the Council before bidding.
requirements.quote: Site visit recommended, to arrange please contact Samantha on info@alton.gov.uk or 01420 83986.

requirements.requirement: Recommend cameras that give image quality suitable for the Police and Courts, and include upgrades for any existing cameras retained.
requirements.quote: Recommendation of cameras which provide good quality images as required by the Police and Courts.

requirements.requirement: Include any upgrades needed where existing cameras are retained.
requirements.quote: Where existing cameras are to be retained, any upgrades to be included.

requirements.requirement: Produce detailed plans and records of the planned location of each device, with the Project Manager.
requirements.quote: Detailed plans and records of the planned location of each device shall be drawn up by the contractor in conjunction with the Project Manager.

requirements.requirement: Install the new system so it is fully operational by 1 November 2026.
requirements.quote: Install the new system to be fully operational by 1st November 2026.

requirements.requirement: Train at least three Council Officers so the Council can achieve the public space surveillance (CCTV) licence.
requirements.quote: To provide training for at least three Officers to ensure the Town Council can achieve the public space surveillance (CCTV) licence.

requirements.requirement: Supply the required CCTV signage and place it.
requirements.quote: To provide the required signage for the CCTV system and its placement.

requirements.requirement: Monitor the system for faults and evaluate each reported fault within 24 hours of the report.
requirements.quote: Monitor the system for any faults and evaluate within 24 hours of the report.

requirements.requirement: Remedy all reported faults within three days, including weekends.
requirements.quote: All reported faults are to be remedied within three days. Weekends shall not be excluded from this arrangement.

requirements.requirement: Ensure the system stores at least 31 days of recordings that Officers and the Police can view.
requirements.quote: Ensure the system stores at least 31 days of recordings to be viewed by Officers and the Police.

requirements.requirement: Be able to review the Council's CCTV retention policy to confirm it meets current requirements.
requirements.quote: The Contractor should be able to review the CCTV retention policy for the Council to ensure it meets current requirements.

requirements.requirement: Test anchor point safety and catenary wire viability throughout the contract, to ISO standards.
requirements.quote: Testing shall include safety tests on anchor points and viability of any catenary wires which may be installed throughout the duration of the contract. Testing shall be carried out to ISO standards.

requirements.requirement: Test all electrical components and certify all wiring and connections as safe.
requirements.quote: All electrical components shall be tested and all wiring, connections etc should be certified safe.

requirements.requirement: Install and anchor all equipment safely and in compliance with Health and Safety regulations.
requirements.quote: All equipment will be installed and anchored such that they are safe and compliant with Health and Safety regulations.

requirements.requirement: Adopt safe working practices at all times and fully protect workers and the public.
requirements.quote: The contractor shall ensure safe working practices are adopted at all times and that workers and the public are fully protected.

requirements.requirement: Hold relevant insurance, including professional and public liability, to the value of £10m.
requirements.quote: The contractor will hold the relevant insurance cover including professional and public liability to the value of £10m.

requirements.requirement: Provide all necessary equipment, including cherry pickers and transport vehicles, at the contractor's own cost.
requirements.quote: The contractor will provide all necessary equipment including cherry pickers and vehicles to transport equipment.

requirements.requirement: Fees must cover all works, including dealing with all faults.
requirements.quote: The fees shall cover all works including dealing with all faults.

requirements.requirement: Complete all due diligence before tendering; the Council will not accept liability for additional payments.
requirements.quote: The contractor shall conduct all necessary due diligence in advance of submitting their tender as the Council will not accept liability for additional payments.

requirements.requirement: The contractor and all employees must hold the required electrical installation qualifications, including the HERS certificate.
requirements.quote: The contractor and all their employees shall hold the required electrical installation qualifications including the HERS certificate.

requirements.requirement: Hold 'working at height' certificates for operating a cherry picker.
requirements.quote: The contractor should also hold ‘working at height’ certificates for the operation of a cherry picker.

requirements.requirement: Cover the contract locations, starting with four camera positions in the High Street, plus the ANPR location, Market Square, Public Gardens, Jubilee Playing Fields and Anstey Park.
requirements.quote: Four positions in the High Street for CCTV cameras

requirements.requirement: Optionally comment on CCTV options for Kings Pond car park and Holybourne Play Area (no electricity supply); these sites are outside the tender scope.
requirements.quote: These are outside the scope of the tender, but contractors are invited to comment on potential options in these locations.

requirements.requirement: Submit the written tender to the Town Clerk by 4:30pm on Friday 14 August (2026) by post or email.
requirements.quote: Written tenders are to be submitted to the Town Clerk by 4:30pm on Friday 14th August posting or emailing.

requirements.requirement: Seal the tender pack, with no external markings identifying the supplier.
requirements.quote: The packs shall not have any external means of identifying the potential supplier.

requirements.requirement: Include a technical specification covering experience and proposed approach to the works.
requirements.quote: The technical specification (details of experience, proposed approach to the works etc).

requirements.requirement: Provide a separate document giving the total price for initial installation and annual maintenance over three years.
requirements.quote: A separate document confirming the total price for the initial installation and annual maintenance contract for a three-year period.

requirements.requirement: Provide names and contact details of two references for similar services delivered in the past 12 months.
requirements.quote: The names and contact details of two references who have received a similar service in the past 12 months.

requirements.requirement: Do not contact Councillors or staff to encourage or support the tender outside the process.
requirements.quote: Bidders are prohibited from contacting Councillors or staff to encourage or support their tender outside of this process.

requirements.requirement: Submit a compliant tender, as only compliant tenders are evaluated (including supply time and acceptance of terms).
requirements.quote: Each compliant tender will be judged against the following criteria:-

requirements.requirement: Provide evidence of the experience, capability and qualifications of key personnel (scored under General Suitability).
requirements.quote: Evidence of the experience, capability and qualifications of key personnel

requirements.requirement: Meet and ideally exceed minimum requirements, adding innovation and detail, to reach the highest scores.
requirements.quote: to achieve the highest scores available the Applicant must not only meet but exceed the Council’s minimum requirements, where these are stated.

requirements.requirement: For email submissions, use the subject 'Confidential: CCTV Tender' and send to townclerk@alton.gov.uk by the same deadline.
requirements.quote: Email submissions are also accepted and should be sent to townclerk@alton.gov.uk with the subject ‘Confidential: CCTV Tender’.

requirements.requirement: Postal tenders must reach Alton Town Council, Town Hall, Market Square, Alton GU34 1HD by 4:30pm on Friday 14 August 2026.
requirements.quote: The tender information should be sent to Alton Town Council, Town Hall, Market Square, Alton, Hampshire, GU34 1HD by 4:30pm on Friday 14th August 2026.

requirements.requirement: Accept payment on receipt of a satisfactory VAT invoice, possibly in instalments, with full terms agreed after award.
requirements.quote: Payment for services will be made upon the receipt of a satisfactory VAT invoice and may be made in one or more instalments.
